name: roast-my-design-system
description: Your AI can write the UI. This makes sure it writes your UI. A deterministic scanner scores your design system 0-100 against 34 public repos, scopes the scan with .roastignore, and writes rules for Claude, Cursor, GitHub Copilot and Windsurf with --apply.
author: Greg Kozakiewicz (https://gregkozakiewicz.com)
